name: lichess-puzzles
description: Lichess chess puzzles in a small pane while Claude works, anonymous or signed in to your Lichess account. English and French.

autoOpen.title: Open on every prompt
autoOpen.description: Opens the puzzle pane when Claude starts working

autoClose.title: Close when all is done
autoClose.description: Closes the pane once Claude is done and the started puzzle is over

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Lichess puzzle difficulty, relative to your rating

pieces.title: Pieces
pieces.description: Unicode symbols or letters (if your terminal draws ♞ badly)

size.title: Board size
size.description: small (2 columns per square), medium (3), large (5×3)

boardTheme.title: Board colors
boardTheme.description: auto follows Claude Code's theme (dark or light)

language.title: Language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; English otherwise
